name: Adaptive Query + Gated Mean Residual
tagline: Augments ClimaX cross-attention with a context-conditioned query delta and a sigmoid-gated residual injection of the variable-mean token.
formula:
$$\bar{x}_\ell = \tfrac{1}{V}\sum_v x_{\ell,v},\quad q_\ell = q_0 + W_q\,\mathrm{LN}(\bar{x}_\ell)$$
$$a_\ell = \mathrm{MHA}(q_\ell,\,X_\ell,\,X_\ell),\quad g_\ell = \sigma\!\bigl(W_g\,\mathrm{LN}(a_\ell)+b_g\bigr)$$
$$z_\ell = a_\ell + g_\ell \odot \bar{x}_\ell$$

key_hyperparams.name: W_q init
key_hyperparams.role: query-adapter weight (zero-init keeps pretrained baseline at start)

key_hyperparams.name: b_g
key_hyperparams.role: gate bias so sigmoid starts near 0.018

diff_from_baseline: Extends the cross_attention baseline by making the learnable query content-conditioned via a zero-initialized linear adapter and adding a sigmoid-gated residual from the per-location variable mean.

name: Inter-Variable Transformer Block + Context Query
tagline: Pre-aggregator transformer block (variable self-attention plus FFN) followed by cross-attention with a query conditioned on mean and max context.
formula:
$$\tilde{X} = X + W_{\!o}\,\mathrm{MHA}\bigl(W_{\!h}\mathrm{LN}(X)\bigr)\!,\ X' = \tilde{X} + \mathrm{FFN}(\mathrm{LN}(\tilde{X}))$$
$$c = [\mathrm{mean}_v X' \,\Vert\, \max_v X'],\quad q = q_0 + g(c)$$
$$z = \mathrm{MHA}(q,\,X',\,X')$$

key_hyperparams.name: hidden_dim
key_hyperparams.role: bottleneck for inter-var SA and FFN

diff_from_baseline: Inserts a full transformer block (self-attention plus FFN, both bottlenecked to D/2 with zero-initialized output projections) over the variable axis before the standard cross-attention, and conditions the query on a concatenated mean+max context.

name: Anomaly-Aware Dual-Path Aggregator
tagline: Mixes pretrained cross-attention with an anomaly-weighted softmax pool, blended via a context gate and anchored by a residual mean.
formula:
$$\bar{x}=\mathrm{mean}_v X,\ \delta=X-\bar{x},\ s=\delta^{2}\text{ averaged over }v,\ c=W_c[\bar{x}\,\Vert\,s]$$
$$a^{(1)} = \mathrm{MHA}(q_0,X,X)$$
$$\alpha = \mathrm{softmax}_v\bigl(W_a(X+\tanh(\delta_p)\,(X-\bar{x})+c)\bigr),\quad a^{(2)} = \sum_v \alpha_v X_v$$
$$g = \mathrm{softmax}(W_g c),\quad z = \mathrm{LN}\bigl(g_1 a^{(1)} + g_2 a^{(2)} + \bar{x}\bigr)$$

key_hyperparams.name: delta
key_hyperparams.role: scalar that scales centered residual in anomaly score (passed through tanh)

key_hyperparams.name: gate_proj
key_hyperparams.role: context-driven mixture between attention path and anomaly path

init_recovers: Approximately ClimaX cross-attention plus mean residual
diff_from_baseline: Adds a second softmax-pooling path that scores each variable by anomaly relative to local consensus, mixes it with the pretrained cross-attention via a softmax gate over a mean+spread context, and applies a LayerNorm residual anchor on the variable mean.

name: Inter-Variable SA + Cross-Attention (Two-Stage)
tagline: Self-attention across variables with a learnable scalar gain, followed by the standard learnable-query cross-attention; both stages wrapped in post-norm residuals.

key_hyperparams.name: alpha
key_hyperparams.role: learnable scale on the inter-variable self-attention contribution

init_recovers: Cross-attention baseline when alpha shrinks toward 0 (with norm)
diff_from_baseline: Prepends an inter-variable multi-head self-attention block with a learnable scalar gain and post-norm residual to the original cross-attention aggregator, and lowers the learning rate to 3e-4.

name: Hierarchical Group Mean + Cross-Attn
tagline: Buckets the 48 ClimaX variables into 8 physically motivated groups, mean-pools within each group, then cross-attends across the 8 group tokens.

key_hyperparams.name: num_groups
key_hyperparams.role: constants, surface, geopotential, u-wind, v-wind, T, RH, q

key_hyperparams.name: lambda (mean_weight)
key_hyperparams.role: scalar weight on residual global mean

init_recovers: Cross-attention over 8 group tokens at init
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the V=48 cross-attention input with G=8 hand-coded group-mean tokens (one per physical variable family across pressure levels) and adds a small learnable residual injection of the all-variable mean.
